title: Test-harness submission spec
description: The end state a test needs a submission to be in. The builder walks the application to that state through the real services; the test never scripts the journey.

tag.description: Parallel-isolation key. Appended to the submission title so assertions can attribute rows by tag rather than by id.

context.description: urlPath of the context to submit to.

submitted.description: Defaults to true. An EXPLICIT false seeds a wizard-resumable draft at parity: no dateSubmitted, submissionProgress set to the first wizard step, author canChangeMetadata.

participants.description: Stage assignments to add before any decision is recorded, the way the Participants panel adds them. Editorial participants are what make a submission's round show recommendation controls, decision buttons and notification recipients.

role.description: Role key of the user group to assign under (manager, sectionEditor, author, ...); defaults to the user's first group in the context.

recommendOnly.description: The 'Recommend only' toggle: the participant records recommendations instead of decisions. Applied to an existing assignment too, the way editing a participant does.

decisions.description: Editorial decisions to record, in order, through the real decision service. Each drives the real stage progression, hooks and notifications.

decision.description: Decision type name, lower-camel-case of the decision type class (sendExternalReview, requestRevisions, accept, newExternalRound, sendToProduction, decline, ...). Validated against the app's own decision-type roster.

editor.description: username recording the decision; defaults to the first manager/editor enrolled in the context.

reviewRounds.description: Reviewers per review round. Entry i targets review round i+1 of the submission's review stage; the round must exist (created by a promoting decision) or the app's default promoting decision is applied for round 1.

status.description: Defaults to invited. 'accepted'/'declined' run the reviewer's own confirm action; 'completed' additionally submits the review through the reviewer's own step-3 form; 'confirmed' additionally has the editor confirm it, the way reading the review from the Reviewers panel does.

method.description: Review method for this assignment; defaults to the context's default review mode. Only an open review is readable by the author.

commentsForAuthor.description: The review comment the reviewer shares with the author. Requires a completed status.

commentsForEditor.description: The review comment the reviewer addresses to the editor alone. Requires a completed status.

recommendation.description: Localized title of one of the context's reviewer recommendation options ('Accept Submission', 'Revisions Required', ...). Requires a completed status.

attachment.description: Attach a reviewer file to the completed review, the way the reviewer's upload step does.

published.description: Publish the current publication through the real publish path.
